subject: Fix Damerau-Levenshtein (#12)
summary: The pre-#12 `damerau_levenshtein` was actually computing optimal-string-alignment distance: each substring could be edited at most once, so adjacent transpositions could not be re-used. subject: Fix Jaro and Jaro-Winkler when the length is one
summary: The parent implementation returns 0.0 for all pairs of one-element sequences, including identical characters. Thus jaro("a", "a") returns 0.0 and jaro_winkler("a", "a") returns 0.1 instead of 1.0. The fix compares the elements in the length-one guard, returning 1.0 for equal inputs and 0.0 otherwise while preserving protection against search-range underflow. The selected regression test was added by this fix. No tests were executed.
